seoTitle: Free Pre-Trade Checklist for Disciplined Traders | TradifyApp
seoDesc: Download the free pre-trade checklist used by disciplined traders. Covers HTF bias, entry validation, risk management, and psychology checks. Print and use before every trade.
subtitle: Complete every item before executing a trade. No exceptions.
section1Item1: Confirmed daily/4H trend direction aligns with my rule set
section1Item2: Checked TradifyApp rule engine — no active session restrictions triggered
section1Item3: Verified no high-impact news within my restricted news window
section1Item4: HTF bias is clear and matches my allowed trading direction rules
section2Title: 2. Entry & Exit Validation Against Session Rules
section2Item1: Entry setup matches one of my pre-defined strategy templates
section2Item2: Stop loss is placed beyond structure — not an arbitrary round number
section2Item3: Take profit is at the next key level with minimum acceptable R:R
section2Item4: This trade passes my TradifyApp entry checklist rule (if configured)
section3Item1: Checked current drawdown distance in TradifyApp Prop Tracker
section3Item2: This trade's risk will NOT push me within 50% of my daily drawdown limit
section3Item3: Total open risk across all positions stays within max drawdown threshold
section3Item4: If trailing drawdown: verified high-water mark and current cushion
section4Item1: Calculated position size using TradifyApp risk calculator (not mental math)
section4Item2: Risk per trade is ≤ 2% of current drawdown allowance (not account balance)
section4Item3: No correlated positions open that double my effective exposure
section4Item4: Lot size matches my pre-committed session rule — no manual override
section5Item1: Logged my pre-session mood in TradifyApp (calm / anxious / frustrated / confident)
section5Item2: Not revenge trading after a previous loss this session
section5Item3: Not FOMO entering because I missed the initial move
section5Item4: I slept enough, I'm not fatigued, and I can think clearly right now
section6Item1: I have not exceeded my max trades per session rule
section6Item2: My session loss limit has NOT been hit — TradifyApp confirms green status
section6Item3: I am trading within my defined session hours (not outside my window)
section6Item4: This is a planned trade from my watchlist — not a spontaneous impulse entry
ctaTitle: This Checklist Is Automated Inside TradifyApp
ctaDesc: Every item you just checked is enforced automatically when you connect your MT5 account. Drawdown tracking, rule enforcement, position sizing, session limits — all running in real time.
